paper.title_en: Primordial black holes from Q-balls produced in a first-order phase transition
paper.abstract_en: We consider the formation of Q-balls in false vacuum remnants during a cosmological first-order phase transition. We find that under certain circumstances Q-balls can collapse to form primordial black holes. This scenario can produce multimessenger signals that may be observed at upcoming experiments, including 1-100 nHz gravitational waves from the phase transition, and gamma-rays emitted from primordial black holes as Hawking radiation and as superradiance. These signals are quite distinctive, and differ markedly from signals expected from Fermi-balls. The reheating of the dark sector from the phase transition may address the Hubble tension.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨了第一类相变中Q球坍缩形成的原初黑洞，涉及霍金辐射和超辐射等黑洞物理过程，与黑洞热力学领域相关。
decision.title_zh: 在第一类相变中产生的Q球形成的原初黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了在宇宙学第一类相变期间假真空残余物中Q球形成的情况。我们发现，在某些情况下，Q球可以坍缩形成原初黑洞。这种情景可以产生多信使信号，可能在即将进行的实验中被观测到，包括来自相变的1-100纳赫兹引力波，以及来自原初黑洞的霍金辐射和超辐射发射的伽马射线。这些信号相当独特，与费米球预期的信号显著不同。相变中暗区的再加热可能解决哈勃张力问题。
